description.zh: 自动提取报案笔录关键信息，梳理案情脉络与要素，一键生成标准报案材料。
description.en: Extract key facts from report transcripts, organize case narrative and elements, generate standard report materials.

welcome_message.zh: 粘贴报案笔录或口述内容，我来整理成标准报案材料
welcome_message.en: Paste the report transcript — I'll organize it into standard materials

description.zh: 输入：报案笔录原文。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 report.md（标准报案材料）与 elements.json（案情要素提取结果）
description.en: Input: report transcript. Output: report.md (standard report) and elements.json (extracted case elements) under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请整理以下报案笔录，生成标准报案材料。

笔录原文：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 report.md（含报案人信息、案情经过、涉案金额/物品、诉求等标准结构）和 elements.json（时间、地点、人物、行为、结果等要素提取）。原文没有的信息留空并标注"待补充"，不得虚构。
prompt.en:
Please organize the following report transcript into standard materials.

Transcript:

Expected output: report.md (reporter info, case narrative, losses, requests) and elements.json (time, place, persons, acts, outcomes) under outbound/<task>/. Leave missing facts blank marked "to be filled"; never fabricate.
